title: featureInputLayer
summary: Create a feature input layer compatibility object.
description: `featureInputLayer(inputSize)` creates host metadata for feature-input network definitions.
behaviors: `inputSize` may be a positive integer scalar or numeric vector of positive integers.
`Name`, `Description`, `Normalization`, and other common name-value options are stored as properties.

example.input:
layer = featureInputLayer(inputSize)
layer = featureInputLayer(inputSize, Name, Value)

gpu_residency: Layer construction is host metadata work and has no provider kernel.
